complexity.notes: Correct but does a full digit-array -> string -> big-integer -> string -> digit-array round trip. As usual, bit-level bignum work is not counted in the reported complexity, but in practice the string/integer conversions are exactly what make this slower than the intended approach: ||a single pass from the least significant digit, turning trailing 9s into 0s and stopping as soon as a digit below 9 is found (prepending a 1 only when every digit was 9)||, which is also O(n) time but avoids the conversions entirely and needs no intermediate number. The nested generator expressions are a bit hard to read; a direct loop would be clearer.
complexity.summary: Joins the digits into a string, parses it as one big integer, adds one, and splits the result back into a list of digit characters converted to ints.
